topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, I'll be, the news that me surprise party’s been called off has spread through the village like a fox through a chicken coop. I reckon it’s for the best, though. Harvest season’s upon us, and every pair of hands counts. There’s no time for merrymaking when the earth has given us good crops to tend to and gather. I’ve always said, the soil and the heavens above guide our lives more than any feast or festival. Besides, I reckon the good folks of the village will have their own reasons to celebrate when we see a bountiful harvest, and that’s a joy I’d share in gladly. Saint Benedict will have his day, and the fields will have theirs. Each in its time, and all in good order.
